verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single homepage line saying models can be deployed on optimized Inference Endpoints on a GPU in a few clicks, which points to a first-party dedicated-deployment product. Nothing in the pack documents autoscaling, scale-to-zero, replica limits, or isolation from the shared serverless Inference Providers pool. The rest of the material covers the shared provider-routing API, which is the opposite of dedicated capacity. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling configuration, explicit dedicated or isolated capacity guarantees, GPU instance selection details, in-depth Inference Endpoints docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: Deploy on optimized [Inference Endpoints](/pricing#endpoints) or update your [Spaces applications](/pricing#spaces) to a GPU in a few clicks.
